map.基于 Cariogram 模型的龋病风险多因素评估。综合 7 项临床因素，判断未: A multi-factor caries-risk assessment based on the Cariogram model. Integrates 7 clinical factors to judge future new-caries risk and help plan personalized prevention.
map.Cariogram 龋病风险评分 = 7 项临床因素（龋坏经历、菌斑量、饮食含糖: Cariogram caries-risk scoring = 7 clinical factors (caries experience, plaque amount, sugary-diet frequency, fluoride use, saliva secretion and buffer capacity, mutans streptococci, clinical judgment) each scored 0-2, summed for a max 14; total <=3 is low risk (>80% chance no new caries), 4-8 is moderate, >=9 is high; based on this set a personalized prevention plan, with recall interval 6-12 months by risk (high risk 3-6 months).
map.本工具参考 Cariogram 风险模型，输出为风险分级与可干预因素提示，非官方: This tool references the Cariogram risk model; output is risk grading and modifiable-factor hints, not official software results.
map.氟化物暴露、唾液分泌等为保护性因素，充足时风险降低: Fluoride exposure and saliva secretion are protective factors; adequate levels lower risk.
map.评估结果供口腔预防保健参考，具体诊疗请由口腔医师判断: Results are for oral preventive-care reference; specific diagnosis follows the dentist.
map.高龋患者录入饮食、菌群、氟暴露等七因素，工具输出风险等级与主要可控因素。: For high-caries patients, enter seven factors such as diet, flora and fluoride exposure; the tool outputs the risk level and main controllable factors.
map.儿童防龋随访，提示加强局部用氟与饮食控糖的重点。: For children's caries-prevention follow-up, highlight topical fluoride and sugar control.
map.正畸期间复评风险，关注托槽周围清洁难度。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不: Re-assess risk during orthodontics, focusing on cleaning difficulty around brackets. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：7 因素（高糖摄入、变异链球菌高、氟低、唾液少…）\n输出：高风险，主要可:
Input: 7 factors (high sugar intake, high mutans streptococci, low fluoride, low saliva...)
Output: high risk, main controllable factors = diet and fluoride exposure; suggest fluoride, sealants, sugar control and 3-6 month recall.
map.常用维度含龋病经历、饮食（糖）、菌群（变链）、氟、唾液缓冲/流率、社会因素与既往: Common dimensions include caries experience, diet (sugar), flora (mutans), fluoride, saliva buffer/flow, social factors and past fillings, weighted into risk.
map.未来 1~2 年新龋概率高，应强化防龋（专业涂氟、窝沟封闭、饮食管理）并缩短复查: High probability of new caries in the next 1-2 years; intensify prevention (professional fluoride, fissure sealants, diet control) and shorten recall interval.
map.评分能代替口腔检查吗？: Can the score replace an oral exam?
map.辅助，方案与确诊以口腔医师检查为准；有活跃龋及时就诊。: an aid; plan and diagnosis follow the dentist's examination; for active caries visit promptly.
map.关于「龋病风险 Cariogram 评分」: About the Caries Risk Cariogram Scoring
map.Cariogram 由瑞典 Bratthall 教授团队开发，通过龋病经历、细菌: Cariogram was developed by Professor Bratthall's team in Sweden; it integrates caries experience, bacteria, diet, plaque, fluoride and saliva to predict new-caries risk, presenting it intuitively as the 'chance of avoiding new caries', a common evidence-based prevention model.
